output.question: Who is the parent company of Bath & Body Works?
output.answer: The Bath & Body Works retail brand belongs to Bath & Body Works, Inc. (NYSE: BBWI), which is listed on its own and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. Bath & Body Works, Inc. is the company formerly called L Brands, Inc. It took its current name in August 2021, when Victoria's Secret was spun off. That makes 'L Brands' the old name of the same company, not a separate parent that exists today. Daniel Heaf is listed as CEO.

key_facts.fact: Wikipedia's Bath & Body Works article says the retailer's parent company is Bath & Body Works, Inc.
Bath & Body Works, Inc. was formerly known as L Brands, Inc. and changed its name in August 2021.
Bath & Body Works, Inc. trades on the NYSE under the ticker BBWI and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. Its page names no parent company.
Daniel Heaf is listed as Chief Executive Officer and Director of Bath & Body Works, Inc.
Wikipedia's navigation box for the parent company lists Victoria's Secret under 'Former' brands.

passages.quote: For the parent company of the retailer, see Bath & Body Works, Inc.
The company was formerly known as L Brands, Inc. and changed its name to Bath & Body Works, Inc. in August 2021.
Bath & Body Works, Inc. operates as a specialty retailer of personal care and home fragrance products.

caveats: Several low-quality websites still say L Brands owns Bath & Body Works, and one names Victoria's Secret as the parent. Both claims are out of date or wrong: L Brands renamed itself Bath & Body Works, Inc. in 2021, and Victoria's Secret is now a separate company.
Bath & Body Works, Inc. is publicly traded and has no corporate parent. Its shareholders own it.
Neither page gave a date for the August 2021 Victoria's Secret spin-off. The date comes from search-result summaries, not a page I opened.
I did not open a primary source such as the company's investor-relations site or SEC filings. The sources are StockAnalysis and Wikipedia.
